thag1.50:1.1: Dharaṇī ca siccati vāti māluto vijjutā carati nabhe, upasammanti vitakkā, cittaṃ susamāhitaṃ mamā 'ti. || || Vimalo thero. Vaggo pañcamo.
thag1.50:2.0: uddānaṃ: Sirivaḍḍho Revato thero Sumaṅgalo Sānusavhayo Ramaṇīyavihārī ca Samiddh' -Ujjaya-Sañjayo Rāmaṇeyyo ca so thero Vimalo ca raṇañjayo 'ti.
